summary: Occlusion samples exclude provably unpainted rounded surface corners while retaining owned text samples and strict unknown/coverage gates.
invariants: Only supported childless HTML surfaces use CSS-normalized per-corner px/percent radii and a conservative antialias boundary band.
Surface domains are local to each leaf; owned text fragments remain independent and contribute to the coarse union and all text seeds.
Complex paint or mapping effects retain the prior rectangle/unknown behavior; excluded samples are never counted as visible or known.
The 5 percent unknown limit, nonempty known evidence, actual cover detection, original HTML/PNG and QID geometry remain unchanged.
Occlusion, DOM and measurement cache identities change together; retained evidence is remeasured instead of relabeled.
forbidden: Unknown-to-pass substitution, threshold weakening, exclusion of owned text or inherited parent clipping domains.
Removing unsupported paint evidence or mutating authored content to obtain a sensor pass.
